'''MandalMotors Hall''' was a charcoal-[[gray]] building made of [[Granite/Legends|granite]], located on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], in the capital city of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]. Donated to the community by the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] company, the hall served as a meeting place for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]] to discuss matters of importance, either amongst themselves or with the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']].

In the year [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], current ''Mand'alor'' [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] held a meeting in the hall with several chieftains, veteran [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and heads of companies including MandalMotors' own [[Jir Yomaget]]. The clan leaders and Fett discussed the direction Mandalore would take in the growing [[Second Galactic Civil War|galactic war]], in which Fett declared that Mandalore would remain neutral, but there would be no ban on individuals taking up mercenary work for either side. Also, at the behest of the Mandalorian known as [[Graad]], Fett would issue an order for two million Mandalorians throughout the galaxy to return to Mandalore in order to help the ongoing restoration of the planet in the wake of the [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|devastation]] incurred during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He would also declare [[Goran Beviin]] as acting ''Mand'alor'' during the meeting, for the brief time he would be away on a hunt for [[Jaing Skirata]] and a way to cure his terminal illness.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
